tests.reason: Untestable (no way): Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS has no OSC 633 parser and drops the sequence silently without a target-state reading or log. The Mac app parses OSC in the shared core, not in its own frontend. Read tag v1.4.0 (ghostty-xpli4r8n1mqrzhbgxmkj4jfbpsjsqm3m-derived-source-tar, SHA256 d692bb9b), the source of the bundle version 1.4.0 the hosted run records: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Surface View/SurfaceView_AppKit.swift:389 creates each Mac surface through ghostty_surface_new (src/apprt/embedded.zig:617,1842), whose core Surface drives terminal.Stream in src/termio/Termio.zig:14,66 with the one StreamHandler every app runtime uses, and the shared core parser (src/terminal/osc.zig and src/terminal/stream.zig) carries no OS branch. In that shared core parser, src/terminal/osc.zig:455-505 lists 133 and no 633; state .@"6" at :972-975 sends 3 to unknownOrInvalid at :748-753 (unknown_max_bytes=0 at :496), so end() at :1092-1103 returns null and logs nothing. The embedded runtime behind the Swift app (src/apprt/embedded.zig) has no OSC 633 path, and macos/Sources names OSC only for the OSC 8 and OSC 52 actions the core raises (macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:527-536,813-888, macos/Sources/Features/Terminal/BaseTerminalController.swift:1622).

Read tag v1.4.0 (ghostty-xpli4r8n1mqrzhbgxmkj4jfbpsjsqm3m-derived-source-tar, SHA256 d692bb9b), the source of the bundle version 1.4.0 the hosted run records: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Surface View/SurfaceView_AppKit.swift:389 creates each Mac surface through ghostty_surface_new (src/apprt/embedded.zig:617,1842), whose core Surface drives terminal.Stream in src/termio/Termio.zig:14,66 with the one StreamHandler every app runtime uses, and the shared core parser (src/terminal/osc.zig and src/terminal/stream.zig) carries no OS branch. In that shared core parser, src/terminal/osc.zig:455-505 lists 133 and no 633; state .@"6" at :972-975 sends 3 to unknownOrInvalid at :748-753 (unknown_max_bytes=0 at :496), so end() at :1092-1103 returns null and logs nothing. The embedded runtime behind the Swift app (src/apprt/embedded.zig) has no OSC 633 path, and macos/Sources names OSC only for the OSC 8 and OSC 52 actions the core raises (macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:527-536,813-888, macos/Sources/Features/Terminal/BaseTerminalController.swift:1622).

tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): at shipped defaults Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS raises nothing a run can read when OSC 133;D arrives, so the cell is undecidable without a user config change. Traced in tag v1.4.0 (SHA256 d692bb9b): src/terminal/osc.zig:1180 parses 133, the exit code is an option of that parser (src/terminal/osc/parsers/semantic_prompt.zig:77-111), src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:918-965 passes it to the effect callback, src/termio/stream_handler.zig:1475-1508 turns end_command into stop_command at :1493, and src/Surface.zig:1198-1225 emits command_finished with the exit code and the measured duration. The Mac app returns immediately on the shipped default: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:1642-1712 reads notifyOnCommandFinish and returns when it is never (src/config/Config.zig:1214), the action defaults to bell without notify (:1228) behind a five-second floor (:1265), and only a user setting that gate reaches the bell or a UNUserNotificationCenter banner (:1599,:1620) outside the text cells and window screenshot the run measures. The D mark and the A/B/C cycle are stored as row content, visible only to the debug inspector (src/inspector/widgets/page.zig:291 via src/input/Binding.zig:688-691) and the snapshot serializer (src/terminal/snapshot/grid.zig:259), neither of which is a default-launch reader.

tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): at shipped defaults Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS raises nothing a run can read when OSC 133;D arrives, so the cell is undecidable without a user config change. Traced in tag v1.4.0 (SHA256 d692bb9b): src/terminal/osc.zig:1180 parses 133, the exit code is an option of that parser (src/terminal/osc/parsers/semantic_prompt.zig:77-111), src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:918-965 passes it to the effect callback, src/termio/stream_handler.zig:1475-1508 turns end_command into stop_command at :1493, and src/Surface.zig:1198-1225 emits command_finished with the exit code and the measured duration. The Mac app returns immediately on the shipped default: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:1642-1712 reads notifyOnCommandFinish and returns when it is never (src/config/Config.zig:1214), the action defaults to bell without notify (:1228) behind a five-second floor (:1265), and only a user setting that gate reaches the bell or a UNUserNotificationCenter banner (:1599,:1620) outside the text cells and window screenshot the run measures. The D mark and the A/B/C cycle are stored as row content, visible only to the debug inspector (src/inspector/widgets/page.zig:291 via src/input/Binding.zig:688-691) and the snapshot serializer (src/terminal/snapshot/grid.zig:259), neither of which is a default-launch reader.
